approvedBy: User approval of the Quality Control page
rules: Do not redesign the approved Quality Control page or independently restyle its locked shared components.

Keep inspection language conservative and limited to dimensional checking, specification verification, production-stage checking, practical visual review and catalog-supported production organization.

Do not add tolerance values, inspection percentages, inspection frequencies, AQL levels, certifications, laboratory capabilities, accreditation, named test methods or test results without new verified source evidence.

Keep the single supporting inspection illustration labeled Dimensional inspection and visibly disclosed as an Illustrative scene; do not present it as company personnel, equipment, laboratory or photographic evidence.
Keep Visible Surface Condition framed only as practical visual review for requirement discussion; do not turn it into an undocumented acceptance, pass, reject or tolerance standard.
Preserve original technical drawings, symbols, dimensions, units, decimal precision and product-family associations exactly as sourced.
Keep the 20 Type and 12 / 14 / 16 Type packaging examples separate and tied to their catalog pages; do not generalize either method to every product family.
Keep company-level quality wording limited to the catalog page 18 production-stage testing-tool statement and page 3 production-organization concepts unless later verified evidence expands it.
Keep the final RFQ as a local preview until a real submission destination is separately implemented and verified.
